text: Access to customer data is limited by role and reviewed
Data is encrypted at rest and in transit
Security events are logged and monitored
An incident response plan exists and is exercised
A business continuity plan covers the AI service
Staff with data access are vetted and trained
An independent penetration test runs at least yearly
Vulnerabilities are patched within a stated window
Secure development practices are followed
Defenses against prompt injection and data leakage are tested
Model purpose, limits and known failure modes are documented
Training and evaluation data sources are documented
Bias and accuracy testing is performed and recorded
Model outputs are monitored in production
Customers are notified before a model version changes
Customers may audit our controls
Subcontractors are covered by written agreements
Customer data is deleted when the contract ends
Regulatory change is tracked and applied
We carry insurance that covers this service
